questions.q: What happened to Virginia Hall that she persevered through?
a: She lost a leg in an accident
questions.why: Lesson 1 says an accident left her missing half a leg.

questions.q: How many languages did Hall know by graduation?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says she knew five languages.

questions.q: How did Hall end up in the Special Operations Executive?
a: Almost by accident after being denied many times
questions.why: Lesson 2 says she was denied many times before joining almost by accident.

questions.q: What was Hall sent to do in southern France?
a: Build a network of resistance fighters
questions.why: Lesson 3 says she created a network of dozens of people.

questions.q: How was a captured group of agents rescued?
a: An elderly priest in a wheelchair with a hidden radio
